stopRule: Decision 7 case-revision caveat and resume stop (e)
finding: Decision 7 changes cases.frame and cases.site_id without advancing cases.revision.
ingestJob in cases/processing.ts marks a completed build current solely by equality of case revision.
Its result frame/context checks compare against the job's old payload, not the newly bound current case.
Consequently a queued pre-binding build can become current under the new case frame at the same revision.
The manual recipe workspace rejects mappings/packages, but not units, pending builds or current snapshots.
A source case can hold such state: addUnit and requestBuild do not require an assigned site/frame.
prepareCase already advances revision when changing frame/context, showing the existing invalidation rule.
prepareCase assigns frame/context but not site_id: the null-site binding can also overwrite a prepared frame.
reachableOrder: Retain the GeoJSON in an unassigned case; retain increments its revision.
Add manual units through addUnit; that operation increments revision but leaves the case unassigned.
requestBuild at that revision queues a payload with the case's pre-binding frame and context.
Author and approve the manual GeoJSON recipe at the same workspace revision.
Decision 7 execution would replace case.frame and bind site_id, without changing that revision.
When the prior build completes, ingestJob compares its result to its old payload and sees equal revisions.
It marks the job succeeded and writes cases.current_snapshot_id, although the snapshot has the old frame.
qualification: Static path audit only; no source, unit, build, package or snapshot was fabricated or run.
otherReaders: documentCaseTx fingerprints frame/context/siteId, so changed binding stales document inputs explicitly.
The event reader hashes site_id/frame/context/updated_at and notices binding without a counter bump.
Manual workspaceFingerprint covers case id/revision and sources only, not frame/site; it misses this change.
detailFromClient returns the selected current snapshot body without comparing its frame to cases.frame.

behavior: Existing area imports pass the area's analysis CRS and origin to the unchanged normalizer.
It refuses an uncovered CRS, a footprint extent over 50 km, or any extent edge over 50 km from the origin.
These are reference/bound checks, not a place matcher; no nearest-place selection is built.
